units.source_text: 薰大将又像前天偷窥一样，有意走向大公主所居的西廊方向去，这种行径也是讨厌的。

en.t: General Kaoru again deliberately headed toward the west corridor where the First Princess lived, just as he had when peeping the other day; such behavior was distasteful.

units.source_text: 大公主晚上到明石皇后那里去了，众侍女无拘无束地在廊上看月亮，说闲话。

en.t: That evening the First Princess had gone to visit Empress Akashi, and the ladies-in-waiting were relaxing freely on the corridor, looking at the moon and chatting.

units.source_text: 有一人正在弹筝，音节十分美妙，爪音清脆悦耳。

en.t: One of them was playing the koto; the melody was very beautiful, and the sound of her picks was clear and pleasing to the ear.

units.source_text: 薰大将不让她们知道，悄悄地走近去，说道：“为什么‘故故’地弹得如此美妙？”

en.t: General Kaoru approached quietly without letting them notice and said, "Why are you playing so beautifully, so very deliberately?"

units.source_text: 侍女们大吃一惊，来不及放下揭起着的帘子，有一人站起来答道：“‘气调’相似的兄弟不在这里呀！”

en.t: The ladies were greatly startled and had no time to lower the blinds they had raised; one of them stood up and replied, "The brother with a similar tone is not here."

units.source_text: 察其声音，这便是名叫中将君的人。

en.t: Judging from her voice, this was the lady called Chujo no Kimi.

units.source_text: 薰大将也引用《游仙窟》中典故戏答道：“我是‘容貌’相似的母舅呢！”

en.t: General Kaoru also jokingly answered with an allusion to Youxian ku: "I am the maternal uncle who resembles him in appearance."

units.source_text: 他知道大公主不在此，觉得扫兴，问道：“公主总是常在那边的，她在这归省期间做些什么事呢？”

en.t: Knowing that the First Princess was not there, he felt disappointed and asked, "The princess is usually over there; what does she do during this visit home?"

units.source_text: 侍女答道：“不论在哪里，都不做什么事，只是寻寻常常地度日而已。”

en.t: The lady replied, "Wherever she is, she does nothing in particular; she simply passes the days in an ordinary way."

units.source_text: 薰大将想起大公主身份之优越，不知不觉地叹了一口气。

en.t: General Kaoru thought of the First Princess's exalted rank and unconsciously let out a sigh.

units.source_text: 深恐别人诧怪，努力装作无事，立刻拿过侍女们送出来的和琴，不加调整，就弹奏起来。

en.t: Afraid that others would find him strange, he tried hard to act as if nothing had happened, immediately took the wagon the ladies offered him, and began to play without even tuning it.

units.source_text: 这和琴合着律调，其声与秋天的季候非常适合，音节美妙动人。

en.t: The wagon suited the ritsu mode, and its sound matched the autumn season perfectly; the melody was beautiful and moving.

units.source_text: 薰大将弹到半途忽然停止，热心听赏的侍女们异常惋惜，觉得反而难过。

en.t: When General Kaoru suddenly stopped halfway through, the ladies who had been listening intently were deeply disappointed and felt all the more sorrowful.

units.source_text: 薰大将此时心事重重，他正在想：“我的母亲身份不逊于这大公主。

en.t: At this moment General Kaoru was burdened with thoughts, thinking, "My mother's rank was not inferior to that of this First Princess.

units.source_text: 惟大公主乃皇后所生，这一点不同而已，其各受父帝宠爱，亦完全相同。

en.t: The only difference is that the First Princess was born to the Empress; in receiving the love of their imperial fathers, they were entirely the same.

units.source_text: 然而这大公主特别优越，是什么缘故呢？

en.t: And yet this First Princess is especially superior; what can be the reason?

units.source_text: 想来皇后出生的明石浦是个胜境，所以地灵人杰吧。”

en.t: Perhaps Akashi Bay, where the Empress was born, is such a remarkable place that its sacred spirit produces remarkable people."

units.source_text: 又想：“我能娶得二公主为妻，宿命已甚尊贵，若能兼得大公主，可知更好哩。”

en.t: He also thought, "That I was able to marry the Second Princess already shows an exceedingly noble destiny; if I could also have the First Princess, it would surely be even better."
This was truly a vain fantasy.
